subject: EdgeCloud private offer (GCP) — exec approval request: partner revenue carve-out & payment terms
messages:
From: Daniel Park <daniel.park@edgecloud.com>
To: Mina Haddad <mina_haddad@redwood.com>
Cc: EdgeCloud Finance <procurement@edgecloud.com>
Date: Mon, 18 Jan 2027 16:12:00 -0800
Subject: Private Offer: EdgeCloud / Redwood - GCP Marketplace

Mina — thanks for the demo last week. EdgeCloud is ready to move forward with a private GCP marketplace listing but we need a couple of commercial concessions to make the economics work for our channel. High level: we forecast $240k ARR in year one from customers we onboard via our managed services team.

As discussed, the asks are:
- 40% partner rev-share on billings attributable to EdgeCloud-referred customers for the first 12 months.
- 3 month free trial (zero billing) for first-time customers; billing starts month 4.
- Net60 payment terms to align with our cash conversion cycles.

Attached is the proposed term sheet and a quick rev-share model. We need internal approval on Redwood's side to publish the private offer by Feb 1 to capture pipeline. Can you advise next steps and whether we should route to deal desk or execs?

Attachments: EdgeCloud_priv_offer_terms_v2.pdf (term sheet), revshare_model_edgecloud.csv (partner economics)

Thanks,
Daniel Park

Requesting:

I've attached the term sheet and the model. Happy to jump on a call.

Subject: Re: Private Offer: EdgeCloud / Redwood - GCP Marketplace — deal desk analysis

Mina — reviewed the attachments and ran the numbers. Short summary:
- 40% rev-share for 12 months would reduce contribution margin below our threshold for marketplace channel partners given the expected price band for this SKU.
- The requested 3-month free trial plus Net60 materially increases our cash exposure and recognition delay.

Recommendation (deal-desk):
1) Counter with a 6-month elevated rev-share at 35% followed by a step-down to 20% for the remaining 6 months. This limits the long tail margin hit.
2) Replace Net60 with Net45 and require PO within 30 days of listing + a capped credit/clawback clause if refunds occur in first 90 days.
3) Put a total credit cap: maximum of $15k in trial credits tied to verified new customers (no self-referrals).
4) Require Marketplace listing fee and onboarding cost share (EdgeCloud covers the one-time listing fee).

If finance/executive approves, we can accept this structure. Otherwise we should hold standard marketplace terms.

Jonas — tagging you for revenue ops to confirm whether billing changes (Net45) need special handling in Stripe/marketplace flows.

Karthik
Deal Desk Lead — Redwood Inference

From: Marissa Cole <marissa_cole@redwood.com>
To: Mina Haddad <mina_haddad@redwood.com>, Karthik Iyer <karthik_iyer@redwood.com>
Cc: Jonas Weber <jonas_weber@redwood.com>
Date: Fri, 22 Jan 2027 09:03:00 -0800
Subject: Re: Private Offer: EdgeCloud / Redwood - GCP Marketplace — exec decision

Team — reviewed Karthik's recommendation and the attached model. I approve proceeding with a conditional counter to EdgeCloud with these controls:

1) Approve partner rev-share at 35% for months 1–6, stepping down to 20% for months 7–12. No extension of the elevated rate beyond month 6 without a documented performance milestone (gross revenue >= $150k within first 6 months).
2) Approve a 3-month trial but cap total trial credits at $15,000 and require claim validation (list of new customers + trial start dates).
3) Change payment terms to Net45. However, for any invoice > $100k require 50% upfront payment or an acceptable payment guarantee (PO with bank guarantee).
4) Include a 90-day clawback for refunds/chargebacks and a cap on cumulative partner credit exposure.
5) Legal to require standard indemnity and data-residency clause for GCP marketplace listings (no changes to Redwood's standard data processing addendum without Legal sign-off).
6) Listing goes live only after PO is received and legal counterparty signatures are in place. Deadline: PO received within 30 days of counter-approval or offer expires.

Action items:
- Mina: send conditional counter to EdgeCloud today with the updated term sheet.
- Karthik: draft the credit/clawback language and update revshare model.
- Jonas: confirm billing flow for Net45 with upfront condition and add a metadata flag in the offer to enforce clawback.
- Legal: engage and turn around term redlines within 5 business days.

If EdgeCloud accepts these conditions, Finance will prepare a deal memo and we'll finalize the private offer.

Marissa Cole
VP, Revenue Operations & Marketplace
Redwood Inference
